title: The Amnesia Vault Where Records Become Silence

features.name: filing cabinet forest
features.desc-on-touch: Records planted in rows. Each one is aging into silence. You open a drawer and find it full of words that have forgotten themselves.

features.name: dust accumulation
features.desc-on-touch: Files settling into the air. What was archive becomes atmosphere. The records still exist—just no longer readable, just falling.

features.name: forgotten index
features.desc-on-touch: The catalog that was meant to remember. It stands here unmarked and unread. Even its own purpose has been archived away.

features.name: silent broadcasting
features.desc-on-touch: A casing that no longer transmits. Not broken—just finished speaking. The antenna still reaches skyward but the signal is finally complete.

features.name: threshold marker
features.desc-on-touch: The boundary between what was kept and what was allowed to be forgotten. The archive learned it was not the same as memory.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the shed where records went to rest
narr: You sit beside the filing boxes. She's sorting
through names, stories, accounts—and she keeps
stopping, putting things back unsorted. 'Some of
this was never meant to be kept,' she says. You
both understand: forgetting is an archive too.
The shed around you smells of dust and rest.

inscription: the archive discovered that some truths are only preserved by being released

file.name: Records_Withdrawal_Index_Faded.txt
